method: Listed First1KGreek and Perseus canonical-greekLit with one git-tree API call each, read every __cts__.xml from raw.githubusercontent, matched author and work by hand and checked each against its CTS title and TEI sourceDesc. Intake ran through scripts/intake_first1k.py, its fetch served from the same raw files by outputs/greek-intake/run_intake.py to stay under the GitHub API limit.
